summary: CD 2017-CD3 Mortgage Trust filed a Form 8-K/A amending its October 14, 2026 current report solely to add an inadvertently omitted hyperlink to Exhibit 20.1, the Acknowledgment of Replacement Special Servicer. The underlying event is a servicing change: effective October 14, 2026, the directing holder under the COMM 2015-CCRE26 PSA terminated CWCapital Asset Management LLC as special servicer and appointed Torchlight Loan Services, LLC as successor, affecting the Prudential Plaza mortgage loan. No securities are being offered, no deal terms are stated, and the filing carries no shareholder election or economic terms. Routine servicing-related disclosure; no risk-arb angle.
